method: One sequential in-process pass; no warmup, repetition, comparison hardware, or forced GC. Corpus and optional morphology loaded before timing the analysis pass.

memory.meaning: process.memoryUsage samples include runtime, input corpus, morphology, allocation and retained status rows. Sampled peaks are lower bounds on true peaks; deltas are not per-ayah memory costs.

limitations: Single-machine single-pass observation; no statistical confidence interval or comparative speed claim.
Analysis wall time includes status hashing and memory sampling overhead.
No audio verification; browser rendering is tracked separately.
Morphology coverage and speaker interpretation are different questions. Missing morphology remains missing.
